confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Cairo price levels; not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Egypt's currency and inflation have been volatile, so July 2026 levels may differ materially. Restaurant and beer anchors are the firmer ones; hotel and hostel rates vary widely by booking channel, location, and foreign-visitor pricing. Cocktail (about 2.6x beer) and wine_glass (about 2.2x beer) were set from the beer relationship because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX value comes from search-result summaries of the RBA Exchange Rates page, not from opening that page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used as an anchor. The basis is general knowledge of Cairo as a large North African capital with a mix of local and foreign-visitor pricing. The July 2026 window falls in Cairo's hot low tourist season, which may soften some hotel and hostel rates.
